hypothesis: Independent native fixed PROT_NONE requests can distinguish pre-Wine map availability from Wine placement policy at 16-GiB-aligned slots. Failure alone still needs native region occupancy context.
protocol: 31 aligned bases, 64 KiB and 16 GiB each; non-overwriting public SDK vm_map/vm_deallocate; 64-bit address/size assertion; query current region with vm_region_64; release query object ports and only successful own mappings.
host_test: PASS ASan/UBSan 62 requests; fixed/NONE/NONE; own cleanup only; null/nonnul query-port cleanup; early stop on failed cleanup or unexpected returned address
full_xcode_build: PASS; first compile used unsupported iOS mach_vm.h, changed to SDK-declared 64-bit vm_map and rebuilt successfully
install: PASS separate lab bundle, working app retained
device_execution: COMPLETE; code=0; 62 requests, 8 successful and 54 failed
limitations: Pre-Wine JIT-enabled app snapshot, not bare kernel or live CEF map.
Each own mapping released before next request; successful spans do not prove simultaneous packability.
Reservation/NONE success does not prove commit, JIT execution, CEF initialization or login.
Mapping failure can be occupancy or native VM policy; retain region context and exact kernel code.
conclusion: Pre-Wine native map accepts full 16 GiB and 64 KiB at only the four aligned slots in [0x7000000000,0x8000000000). Lower sampled slots are occupied, including a PROT_NONE [0x1000000000,0x7000000000) mapping. This is stronger than a Wine-only placement failure, but does not identify mapping ownership or prove all unaligned/smaller gaps unusable.
cleanup: Only lab PID terminated after copying results; all successful temporary mappings and queried object ports already released by probe.
assessment: NO-GO for simply packing four full pools plus existing FEX/cage into this measured high band. Global feasibility remains undetermined until a correct reduced-demand/ownership model is demonstrated.
next_experiment: Attribute the four genuine CEF pool requests to modules/allocator instances and document exact alignment/size/lifetime contracts from matching implementation before any layout change. Do not repeat this 16 GiB grid or reclaim pre-existing native mappings.
